policy: Exact station/EVSE tariffs only; no network-wide extrapolation from samples, ranges or maxima.

cpos.operatorScope: LadeVerbundPlus / N-ERGIE and participating partners represented under DELVP

verifiedEvidence.observed: Current public tariff table states ad-hoc 0.52 EUR/kWh AC and 0.62 EUR/kWh DC throughout LadeVerbundPlus; registered app 0.48/0.58 and N-ERGIE electricity customers 0.42/0.52.

Blocking-fee applicability is station-dependent. AC: selected stations, 08:00-20:00, from minute 241, 0.05 EUR/min. DC: after 45 minutes, 0.10 EUR/min for registered customers; station information must be checked for applicability.
Each LadeVerbundPlus charge point supports ad-hoc activation by QR without registration.

cpos.reasonPartial: The energy component is published network-wide, but exact blocking-fee applicability is explicitly station-specific. A full exact-cost overlay therefore requires the per-station blocking-fee flag/rule instead of applying the surcharge to every DELVP EVSE.

verifiedEvidence.observed: Mer Connect Me prices are exact by power band: AC up to 49 kW 0.49 EUR/kWh; DC 50-75 kW 0.57 EUR/kWh; HPC 76-400 kW 0.69 EUR/kWh. Mer states no blocking fee. Ad-hoc values are published only as maxima: AC max 0.58, DC max 0.69, HPC max 0.79 EUR/kWh, and prices can vary by station.
Confirms the same Connect Me tariff bands and only maximum ad-hoc values, so maxima cannot be promoted as exact station tariffs.

cpos.reasonPartial: The direct Mer app tariff is exact by power band, but ad-hoc station prices are explicitly variable and only bounded by maxima. Exact station/EVSE ad-hoc mapping is still required.

verifiedEvidence.observed: enercity states ad-hoc/FlexLaden is available at selected stations and that the current price is shown on the station display; selected stations can use dynamic prices.
Official pilot documentation confirms dynamic ad-hoc prices between 0.37 and 0.67 EUR/kWh at 12 public fast-charging stations / 24 charge points, demonstrating station/time variability.
2026 SmartLaden introduces additional app-specific dynamic behavior and time-dependent blocking-fee rules on public AC points; these subscriber rules must remain distinct from ad-hoc pricing.

cpos.reasonPartial: enercity explicitly makes direct prices station-visible and can use dynamic pricing, so a national flat tariff would be incorrect. Exact station/EVSE and time-valid price data is required from the public payment/display backend or AFIR/Mobilithek feed.

verifiedEvidence.observed: Bosch Markwiesenstrasse 46, Reutlingen: 22 kW AC, 2 points, 0.38 EUR/kWh, with live/status provenance described as operator open data via Mobilithek.
Bosch Salzgitter J.-F.-Kennedy-Strasse exposes exact EVSE-level variation: multiple DE*811 AC EVSE at 0.38 EUR/kWh and DC 150/250 kW EVSE at 0.55 EUR/kWh.
Bosch Boxberg lists DC up to 300 kW at 0.65 EUR/kWh with 0.10 EUR/min after 45 minutes and AC at 0.45 EUR/kWh, proving prices and surcharge rules differ by station/connector.

cpos.reasonPartial: Multiple exact station/EVSE prices are verifiable, but they materially vary across Bosch sites and connector types. The 0.38 EUR/kWh sample must not be generalized; full Mobilithek/AFIR or QR/payment mapping is needed for all DE811 EVSE.

verifiedEvidence.observed: Herne Neumarkt 9a: DE*HTL*E200528*1 and *2, 300 kW CCS, exact ad-hoc 0.55 EUR/kWh; source identifies live/operator data and direct card/QR access.
Duisburg Passstrasse 13: two 22 kW AC points at exact direct-payment 0.52 EUR/kWh.
Muelheim Fichtestrasse 66: exact ad-hoc 0.44 EUR/kWh AC, demonstrating station-level variability inside DEHTL.

cpos.reasonPartial: Exact station-level prices are available for a growing subset, but 0.44/0.52/0.55 EUR/kWh examples prove no safe flat tariff. Full exact EVSE coverage should be built from Mobilithek/Eco-Movement-derived open data or public QR/payment pages before completion.
